request: Fix the spelling of 'recieve' to 'receive' in a code comment in app/utils/format.py.
In app/reports/summary.py, rename the local variable tmp to row_count inside the private helper _sum_rows. No behavior changes.

Add a new module app/reports/csv_export.py with a public function export_rows(rows), and call it from app/reports/summary.py so the internal nightly script can also save the summary as CSV. The existing summary output stays the same.
Add a database migration that drops the unused legacy_notes column from the orders table.
In app/auth/session.py, change the session cookie lifetime from 30 days to 7 days.

In app/jobs/cleanup.py, raise the limit to 5000. Note: cleanup.py only reads temporary files and writes a report. It never deletes or changes data. It has two different limits, max_files_scanned and max_report_lines, and the request does not say which one.

Add rate limiting to the public POST /api/orders endpoint so that clients over the limit get HTTP 429. The request gives no limit value. The team's documented default for public endpoints is 100 requests per minute.

case: high-risk by flag count, no hard gate
request: Refactor the internal path helpers in app/storage/, app/reports/, and app/utils/ so they also handle Windows paths. These helpers are internal modules only. For some Windows-style inputs the helpers will return different values than they do today, but the CLI options and output stay the same. Today there are no tests for path handling.
